claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreateObjectOperation on OngoingOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Minor Illusion's core mechanic is creating a sensory artifact — a sound or an image of an object — that persists for the spell's duration. The existing OngoingOperation union only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. No variant exists for creating a non-damaging, non-buffing sensory object. The v4 taxonomy has create_object as an effect atom, but it is not wired into any OngoingOperation or Effect surface variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ObserverAbilityCheck rider on persistent effects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Minor Illusion includes a mechanically deterministic investigation mechanic: an observing creature spends the Study action, makes an INT (Investigation) check against the caster's spell save DC, and the outcome changes the observer's perceptual state. This is observer-initiated, not caster-initiated. All existing ActivationPhase variants are caster-initiated at spell cast time. No surface type models 'while this effect persists, any creature may spend a specific action to attempt an ability check against the effect.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: faint_to_observer outcome / perceptual state effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a successful investigation check the illusion does not end — it 'becomes faint to the creature.' This is a per-observer perceptual state on the illusion artifact: the creature sees it differently while others still perceive it normally. It is not a standard SRD condition (apply_condition), not a termination (expire), and not any other existing v4 effect atom. The v4 taxonomy does not include a modify_perception or faint_to_observer atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: endsOnRecast flag on Duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell ends when cast again. The Duration type (kinds: instantaneous, concentration, timed) has no field for this termination condition. A small addition such as endsOnRecast?: true would cover this and several other spells with the same language.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: location attachment on Attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The illusion is created at a point in space within range, not attached to a creature (target) or to self. Attachment currently lacks a bare location kind (it exists only as AnchorTarget in AnchoredTriggerMechanics). The ongoing_effect family cannot express 'a sensory artifact placed at a location in space' without this variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You create a sound or an image of an object within range...
